_meta.description: Expected minimum baseline per source. Derived from historical avg_jobs_returned in source_reliability + job_pointers history. Edit freely — lower thresholds for low-volume sources.
_meta.how_to_update: Run 'npm run coverage' after a healthy 24h period. Look at INFO lines showing actual rates, then update minimums here.

greenhouse.note: High-volume ATS. GREENHOUSE legacy avg: 740/run. New v3 pipeline: at least 1 new per day expected.

lever.note: LEVER legacy avg: 253/run. Covers Stripe, Anthropic, Linear, Plaid, Ramp, Brex, Rippling.

smartrecruiters.note: SMARTRECRUITERS legacy avg: 468 total. Should produce at least 1 per day when active.

adzuna.note: ADZUNA requires API key. If key present, expect high volume.

himalayas.note: HIMALAYAS legacy avg: 19 total. Low-volume remote board.

working-nomads.note: WORKINGNOMADS — small remote-first board. Expect low volume.

remote-ok.note: REMOTEOK — aggregator. Should produce jobs when active.

gateway.note: Consecutive 503s on infra-gateway = CRITICAL persistence failure. Detected via zero insert_count across all active sources simultaneously.
